name: refuse-unblendable-junction
why: The failure that cost the field session three evaluations per radius: a blend across a junction where several members converge. The refusal must name the junction it measured on the seam — four seam edges at one vertex — and a radius it measured to build, which must build when asked for. That radius comes from a bisection on the kernel, so it is the compiler's: 1.13 mm natively, 0.94 under WebAssembly. The case holds the promise, not the number: `builds_with` writes the named radius into the union's blend and builds it.

message_contains: Largest radius measured to build on this seam:

builds_with.after: Largest radius measured to build on
